name: peerBench
observations: Monorepo for AI benchmarking platform
Homepage: https://peerbench.ai
Package manager: npm, Build: tsup + tsc + tsc-alias, Monorepo tool: turborepo
Published as 'peerbench' on npm (v0.0.11), MIT license, ESM only

name: SDK-0.2
observations: New experimental SDK with runtime-first design
Located at packages/sdk-0.2
Active development target
SDK owns: entity schemas, runner/scorer/provider contracts, storages, aggregators
Runtime owns: data ingestion, orchestration, secrets, migration strategies

name: MastraProvider
observations: Kind: peerbench.ai/llm/mastra
Wraps @mastra/client-js v1 with streaming for TTFT measurement
.agent({ agentId, memory?, requestContext?, providerOptions? }) returns CallableLLM<MastraProvider>
Uses agent.stream() + processDataStream for streaming + TTFT tracking
requestContext replaces old runtimeContext (Mastra v1 rename), from @mastra/core/request-context
memory uses AgentMemoryOption type from @mastra/core/agent
providerOptions uses ProviderOptions from @mastra/core/dist/llm/model/provider-options
getAgents() method internally calls client.listAgents() (v1 API)
CoreMessage from @mastra/core/llm used for message mapping
Chunk types typed loosely with payload casts — NOT imported from @mastra/core/stream

name: LLMAsAJudgeScorer
observations: Kind: peerbench.ai/llm-as-a-judge
Constructor: { callable: CallableLLM, rateLimiter?: RateLimiter } — infrastructure config
score(): { response, rubric, criteria, fieldsToExtract?, systemPrompt?, maxExplanationLength? } — evaluation context
Design: constructor = infrastructure, score() = evaluation context. Rubric/criteria are test-case-dependent.
Returns normalized value 0..1, plus modelSlug and provider from callable
Supports fieldsToExtract (Zod shape) for structured extraction alongside scoring
Uses responseFormat: json_schema for structured output
Accesses this.model.provider.kind and this.model.slug

name: defineRunner
observations: defineRunner(fn) wraps a function as a runner
Enforces structural contract: params must have testCase + target (Callable) + scorer?, return must be { response, score? }
No config object, no auto-validation — runner handles everything itself
RunnerParams type: { testCase: BaseTestCaseV1, target: Callable, scorer?: AbstractScorer }
RunnerResult type: { response: BaseResponseV1, score?: BaseScoreV1 }
Concrete runners narrow target to CallableLLM in their param types

name: OpenRouterProvider
observations: Kind: peerbench.ai/llm/openrouter.ai
Extends AbstractProvider.withKind() directly (no AbstractLLMProvider)
Fetches and caches model list for 24h, calculates costs via Decimal.js
.model({ model }) returns CallableLLM<OpenRouterProvider> wrapping OpenAI callable with cost calculation

name: OpenAIProvider
observations: Kind: peerbench.ai/llm/openai
Extends AbstractProvider.withKind() directly (no AbstractLLMProvider)
Wraps OpenAI SDK with built-in retry logic and rate limiting
.model({ model }) returns CallableLLM<OpenAIProvider> with forward logic inlined as arrow function

name: webapp
observations: Located at apps/webapp
Next.js 15 web app
Uses Drizzle ORM
Uses Supabase for auth + DB
Lives on https://peerbench.ai

name: legacy-sdk
observations: Located at packages/sdk
Being superseded by SDK-0.2

name: EntityChain
observations: Three core entities: TestCase -> Response -> Score
Relationships tracked via IDs (response.testCaseId, score.responseId)
Every entity has: kind, schemaVersion, namespace fields

name: buildSchemaDefiner
observations: Returns a factory function for schema definitions
Each entity type has its own definer: defineTestCaseSchema, defineResponseSchema, defineScoreSchema
Schemas get .new() and .newWithId() factory methods automatically

name: AbstractScorer
observations: Abstract base for all scorers
Defines kind and score() method
Uses same withKind() pattern as providers
BaseScorerResult: { value: number, explanation?: string, metadata? }

name: MCQScorer
observations: Kind: peerbench.ai/mcq
Regex-based multiple choice answer extraction

name: RegexScorer
observations: Generic regex pattern matching scorer

name: AbstractStorage
observations: Abstract base: init(), read(key), readAll(), write(key, value), count()

name: FileStorage
observations: File-based storage with custom codecs

name: JSONFileStorage
observations: JSON array files storage

name: SQLiteStorage
observations: SQLite storage with codec pattern
Uses better-sqlite3

name: HttpStorage
observations: Remote URL-backed storage with codec pattern

name: AbstractAggregator
observations: Abstract base: push({ score, testCase?, response? }), aggregate(config?)
Designed for streaming: push results one-by-one then aggregate
Avoids materializing entire datasets in memory

name: ExampleEchoLLMProvider
observations: Kind: example.echo
Extends AbstractProvider.withKind('example.echo')
.model({ model? }) returns CallableLLM<ExampleEchoLLMProvider>
Echoes last user message (for testing)
NOT exported from peerbench/providers — example only

name: ExampleRestApiLLMAgentProvider
observations: Kind: example.rest-api.agent
Extends AbstractProvider.withKind('example.rest-api.agent')
.model({ model? }) returns CallableLLM<ExampleRestApiLLMAgentProvider>
Demonstrates custom REST API integration
NOT exported from peerbench/providers — example only

name: SDK-Dependencies
observations: zod v4 (NOT v3)
openai v6 (for types like ChatCompletionMessageParam, ResponseFormat)
@mastra/client-js v1 (also uses @mastra/core transitively: RequestContext, AgentMemoryOption, ProviderOptions, CoreMessage)
better-sqlite3 v12
handlebars v4 (for template variables in runners)
decimal.js v10 (for accurate cost calculations in OpenRouter)
jsonrepair v3 (for fixing malformed LLM JSON responses)
uuid v11 (for UUIDv7 ID generation)

name: PackageExports
observations: peerbench → types, errors, utils, constants, helpers (defineRunner, idGeneratorUUIDv7)
peerbench/benchmarks → built-in benchmark runners (mcqRunner, qaRunner)
peerbench/providers → Callable, CallableLLM, LLMResponse, AbstractProvider, ProviderResponse, MastraProvider, OpenAIProvider, OpenRouterProvider
peerbench/schemas → base schemas, schema definers
peerbench/schemas/llm → system prompt schemas
peerbench/schemas/extensions → ExtensionLLMResponseFieldsV1, ExtensionLLMAsAJudgeScoreFieldsV1
peerbench/scorers → abstract + concrete scorers
peerbench/storages → abstract + concrete storages
peerbench/aggregators → abstract + concrete aggregators

name: PathAliases
observations: Uses @/ as path alias (defined in tsconfig.json)
All internal imports use @/ prefix (e.g. @/providers, @/schemas, @/types)

name: ExampleBenchmarks
observations: Located under src/benchmarks/examples/
echo-basic — minimal schema set + runner + storage examples
text-transform — one runner supporting multiple kinds + deterministic scoring
exact-match-scorer — scorer dispatch pattern (algorithmic vs LLM judge)
Built-in peerbench benchmarks under src/benchmarks/peerbench/: MCQ, QA, Multi-turn conversation

name: SimpleSystemPromptSchemaV1
observations: LLM-specific system prompt schema
Located under src/schemas/llm/
Basic system prompt with content and version fields

name: ExtensionLLMResponseFieldsV1
observations: Schema extension for LLM responses
Fields: data, modelSlug, provider, systemPromptId, token/cost fields

name: ExtensionLLMAsAJudgeScoreFieldsV1
observations: Schema extension for LLM-as-a-judge scores
Scorer provider/model/token/cost fields

name: AbstractProvider
observations: Located at src/providers/abstract.ts
Defines kind property and withKind() static factory method
Also exports ProviderResponse<TData> type: { startedAt, completedAt, data }
Only abstract class for providers — no AbstractLLMProvider exists
All providers extend AbstractProvider directly via .withKind()

name: CallableLLM
observations: Located at src/providers/callables/llm.ts
Interface (not class): CallableLLM<TProvider extends AbstractProvider = AbstractProvider> extends Callable<TProvider>
Members: slug: string, forward(args: CallableLLMForwardArgs): Promise<LLMResponse>
Providers return plain { slug, provider, forward } objects satisfying this interface

name: LLMResponse
observations: Located at src/providers/callables/llm.ts (renamed from ChatResponse)
Type: ProviderResponse<string> & { inputTokensUsed?, outputTokensUsed?, inputCost?, outputCost?, timeToFirstToken?, metadata? }
timeToFirstToken: milliseconds from request start to first response token
metadata: Record<string, unknown> for provider-specific metadata
